platform.guide.intro:
Welcome to §l%s§r!
A factory-building server: gather, process and automate resources on a small island above the void.

§e■ New here?§r
1. Create a save with §aNew Game§r in §aSingleplayer§r.
2. Choose the save to enter your island.
3. Follow the goals in the quest panel on the right.

Pick a topic below for details.
platform.guide.topic.saves.title: Saves and Islands
platform.guide.topic.saves.text:
§e■ Lobby§r
The main menu is always open in the lobby: §aSingleplayer§r · §aMultiplayer§r · §aFriends§r · §aTitles & Looks§r · §aHelp§r

§e■ Saves§r
Create up to %d saves in §aSingleplayer§r. Each save keeps its own island, inventory and progress.

§e■ On your island§r
§a/menu§r opens the game menu. §aHelp§r in it and §a/도감§r explain how to play.
platform.guide.topic.together.title: Playing Together
platform.guide.topic.together.text:
§e■ Inviting§r
Inside a save, invite friends with §a/invite§r or share your invite code. Up to %d players per save.

§e■ Joining§r
§aMultiplayer§r lists your invites and the saves you joined. Enter an invite code in §aMultiplayer§r → §aEnter Invite Code§r or with §a/join <code>§r.

§e■ Good to know§r
You can enter a save you were invited to while its host is playing. §a/members§r lists its players.
platform.guide.topic.friends.title: Friends
platform.guide.topic.friends.text:
Add friends and accept requests in the §aFriends§r menu or with §a/friends§r.
Choose a friend to invite them to your save, or block players you don't want to hear from.
platform.guide.topic.cosmetics.title: Titles & Looks
platform.guide.topic.cosmetics.text:
Unlock achievements while you play to earn titles.
Pick a title and name color in §aTitles & Looks§r or with §a/title§r to show them in chat and on your name tag.
platform.guide.topic.rules.title: Commands and Rules
platform.guide.topic.rules.text:
§e■ Rules§r
· Game time passes only while the save's owner is playing.
· There is no fall damage, and you keep your items when you die.

§e■ Commands§r
§a/menu§r game menu · §a/lobby§r to lobby · §a/saves§r choose a save
§a/friends§r friends · §a/invite§r invite · §a/join§r invite code · §a/members§r players
§a/title§r titles · §a/settings§r settings · §a/guide§r server guide
